title: GTA 6: The Festival Is a One-Off Live Music Event, Partly Presented by PlayStation
text: GTA 6: The Festival Is a One-Off Live Music Event, Partly Presented by PlayStation | Push Square Menu Search Share Guest Guest Login | Sign Up Push Square News Reviews Features Videos Games PS Plus Guides Forums Search Keywords Guest Login or Sign Up Home Choose Topics... Manage Topics News Rockstar Games PS5 GTA Events GTA 6: The Festival Is a One-Off Live Music Event, Partly Presented by PlayStation Held in Miami of course by Stephen Tailby 10 hours ago Share: Rockstar Games has announced GTA 6 : The Festival, a special live music event being held to celebrate the launch of the open world action game. Presented in partnership with PlayStation, the one-off event takes place in Miami, Florida on 21st November, 2026. "Experience the music of Vice City and Leonida at Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival, a special live event on November 21 at Mana Wynwood in Miami to celebrate the launch of GTAVI, featuring a star-studded lineup of artists from the game and the official soundtrack." The list of artists is as follows: Cactus Jack presents Travis Scott Don Toliver Kodak Black Sofaygo Cardi B Ca7riel & Paco Amoroso Justice (DJ set) Metro Boomin Nick León B2B DJ Python Prospa B2B Skream Rauw & Friends Suero Tainy The Dare B2B Fcukers (DJ set) They will play "nonstop music" across two stages. If you're interested, you can sign up for the ticket lottery on the official website . The lottery closes at 4pm ET on 10th November, so you don't have long to put your name in the hat. Ticket prices have not been revealed as yet. This is just the latest major marketing beat as we lead up to the launch of GTA 6. Most of the bigger events are happening within Miami and Florida, which is of course the real life inspiration for Vice City and Leonida, where the game takes place.
